properties.why: A clipped evergreen at the north end of the central lawn (audit cell c_-6_-5, 432,66), in the rows of them that the first aerial audit found, but missed because its crown touches the canopy of bprd:900093513. It is a dark solid cone with a sharp shadow in both the MassGIS 15 cm leaf-off photographs (spring 2023 and spring 2025), so it is evergreen; its crown, about 2.4 m across, is read from that cone. Not separable in the USGS NAIP photograph of 7 July 2023. Height 3.5 m as for the others in the row (trees-seen-from-above.geojson).

A clipped evergreen on the central lawn (audit cell c_-6_-5, 675,681), in the rows of them that the first aerial audit found, but this one was not proposed. Its crown, 2.6 m across, is a dark round crown in the USGS NAIP photograph of 7 July 2023; it is a solid dark cone with a sharp shadow in the MassGIS 15 cm leaf-off photographs (spring 2023 and spring 2025), so it is evergreen. Height 3.5 m as for the others in the row (trees-seen-from-above.geojson).

A clipped evergreen on the central lawn (audit cell c_-6_-5, 455,758), in the rows of them that the first aerial audit found, but this one was not proposed. Its crown, 2.3 m across, is a dark round crown in the USGS NAIP photograph of 7 July 2023; it is a solid dark cone with a sharp shadow in the MassGIS 15 cm leaf-off photographs (spring 2023 and spring 2025), so it is evergreen. Height 3.5 m as for the others in the row (trees-seen-from-above.geojson).

One of two evergreens in the oval bed at the south edge of audit cell c_-6_-4. Crown 3.2 m across, a dark round crown in the USGS NAIP photograph of 7 July 2023 (proposed crown C3 in audit cell c_-6_-4); it is a solid dark teal blob in both MassGIS 15 cm leaf-off photographs (spring 2023 and spring 2025), so it is evergreen. Height 3.5 m is an assumption, matching the clipped evergreens elsewhere in the Garden; it was not measured.

The second of two evergreens in the oval bed at the south edge of audit cell c_-6_-4, 7 m south of the first. Crown 3.0 m across, a dark round crown in the USGS NAIP photograph of 7 July 2023 (it lies on the edge of two audit cells, so the audit did not propose it); a solid dark teal blob in both MassGIS 15 cm leaf-off photographs (spring 2023 and spring 2025), so it is evergreen. Height 3.5 m is an assumption, matching the clipped evergreens elsewhere in the Garden; it was not measured.

A clipped evergreen at the lawn edge by the path at the west side of audit cell c_-5_-5 (proposed crown C5 in audit cell c_-5_-5, left 'unsure' by the first pass). Crown 2.5 m across, a dark round crown at the lawn edge in the USGS NAIP photograph of 7 July 2023; a solid dark cone with a sharp shadow in both MassGIS 15 cm leaf-off photographs (spring 2023 and spring 2025), the same as the evergreens already added along the walks, so it is evergreen. Height 3.5 m as for those.

A clipped evergreen at the edge of the walk (proposed crown C4 in audit cell c_-5_-4, left 'unsure' by the first pass). Crown about 2 m across, a dark round crown in the USGS NAIP photograph of 7 July 2023; a solid dark cone with a sharp shadow in both MassGIS 15 cm leaf-off photographs (spring 2023 and spring 2025), the same as the evergreens already added along the walks, so it is evergreen. Height 3.5 m as for those.
